project.visitorDecision: Choose where to visit, cruise or paddle on the Rideau Canal using verified historic stops, channel chainage and official itinerary evidence.
project.primaryAction: Choose Watch the Locks, Cruise or Paddle, inspect sourced places and constraints, then check Parks Canada seasonal notices before visiting.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: Parks Canada's 24 station groups and 47 locks do not mean each portal row is a distinct lockstation; bridge records and visitor-only sites are separate.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: The channel distance table supplies reference chainage and documented bridges, not validated routes, vessel approvals or arrival estimates. Tay diversion reference has two nearby values.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: The 12 km Tay and 39 km lake-country itineraries are trip descriptions, not licensed digital water tracks or proof launches are open today.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: 2026 season ended; 2027 hours, last lockage and bridge openings cannot be inferred from historical hours.

claims.subject: park-access
claims.accessScope: Parks Canada Rideau Canal lockstation grounds and visitor facilities from Thanksgiving to Victoria Day
claims.limitation: Parks Canada warns lockstations are closed to the public and unmaintained in the non-navigation season. This says nothing about whether other municipal parks nearby are open.

claims.subject: route-guidance
claims.limitation: No current season operational status, 2027 lockage times, specific vessel clearances, navigable geometry or overnight availability is certified by this static planner.

claims.subject: other
claims.limitation: Historic documentary photographs carry creator, exact location and license; none proves current access, staffing or conditions.

decisionState.selectedIdField: state.selectedPlaceId for audited stops; state.start/state.end and state.paddleRoute for distinct journey modes
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: Published mirrors of data/rideau-canal/locations.json and navigation-v2.json plus independent JS, Rust and Python source policies. Never inferred coordinates or live route clearance.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: If inventory, source, map or photo fails, retain HTML list and Parks Canada links; never invent current access, vessel passage or route geometry.

scenarios.input: First load in visit mode with Ottawa Locks selected
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Display current seasonal closure and choose among three visit modes; show real source-backed Ottawa lock information.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Parks Canada authority is shown, and future 2027 operating hours remain unknown.

scenarios.input: Change visit interest to villages, half day, then select Merrickville
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Suggest historic village sites, match map, place details and contextual village photo with exact caption.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: A published location is not an approved parking entrance; Google Maps opens place search only.

scenarios.input: Choose Chaffeys, Newboro and back to Chaffeys
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Restore selected stop, linked Parks profile, matching credited photo, Google Maps link and map marker.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: An old photo load may not replace a new selected place.

scenarios.input: Disable JavaScript on the canonical landing page
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show seven sourced visitor stops and two official paddling itineraries as native HTML with all essential source links.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No JS-dependent status, maps, travel time or opening assertion appears.

scenarios.input: Block CARTO and OSM tiles or Leaflet script
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Hide failed map and keep source-linked location list and Google Maps place-search actions.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No blank tile grid, invented parking link or fake route geometry.

scenarios.input: Open before 2027 hours are issued or block inventory fetch
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Retain historical planning and official source links; no live lock-status answer or positive passage assurance.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The 2026 archive never becomes an assumed 2027 schedule.

scenarios.input: Choose Ottawa to Jones Falls at 6 km/h and inspect vessel dimensions
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Display 159 km channel distance with an arithmetic 26.5-hour underway-only example and documented intermediate lock/bridge entries.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Locks, waits, weather and overnight stops excluded; vessel checks never authorize passage.

scenarios.input: Choose Perth to Beveridges, then Upper Brewers to Newboro
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Show 12 km one-day and 39 km two-day official trips, separate put-in/takeout place links and specific hazards.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The boating channel length never replaces Parks Canada's 39 km paddling itinerary.

scenarios.input: Block Wikimedia Commons images and change selected stops
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Keep correct text, official link and map/list state without a stale or falsely attributed image.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: The same photo never masquerades as a different lock.

failures.no-js: The initial HTML contains seven linked, verified visitor destinations with Google Maps place searches and two Parks Canada route summaries.
failures.no-tiles: Hide map and expose source cards, exact place links and independent Google Maps search instead of a blank tile stage.
failures.no-image: Hide failed or slow photo and its entire visual panel; keep exact selected subject text and source. Asynchronous races never mismatch place and author.
failures.stale-data: 2026 hours remain marked historic, lockstations closed during offseason, unknown 2027 schedule, and source-only estimates cannot imply clearance.

qa.scopeNote: Cross-language policy and initial browser journeys passed. Final media-loaded, first-screen and full-site launch checks are pending on latest PR head. Screenshot review and actual public production remains separate.
